description: This file contains functions for generating financial statements reports, including period calculations, account data retrieval, and report data processing within the ERPNext accounting module.

methods.name: get_period_list
methods.description: Generates a list of reporting periods based on fiscal year or date range, with labels and keys for each period.

methods.name: get_fiscal_year_data
methods.description: Retrieves fiscal year start and end dates for given fiscal year range.

methods.name: validate_fiscal_year
methods.description: Validates that fiscal year data has start and end dates, and that end date is not before start date.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Ensures from and to dates are provided and that to_date is not earlier than from_date.

methods.name: get_months
methods.description: Calculates the number of months between start and end dates.

methods.name: get_label
methods.description: Creates a label for a period based on its periodicity and date range.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and processes account balances over specified periods, including filtering, accumulation, and total calculations.

methods.name: get_appropriate_currency
methods.description: Determines the currency to use based on company and filters.

methods.name: calculate_values
methods.description: Calculates account balances for each period from GL entries, considering accumulated values and fiscal year filters.

methods.name: accumulate_values_into_parents
methods.description: Aggregates child account values into parent accounts for hierarchical reporting.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares the final report data structure, formatting account info and balances per period.

methods.name: filter_out_zero_value_rows
methods.description: Filters out account rows with zero balances unless zero display is enabled.

methods.name: add_total_row
methods.description: Appends a total row summing all account balances for the report.

methods.name: get_accounts
methods.description: Retrieves account records for a given company and root type.

methods.name: filter_accounts
methods.description: Filters and sorts accounts into hierarchical order with indentation levels.

methods.name: sort_accounts
methods.description: Sorts accounts based on report type, root type, or name/number.

methods.name: set_gl_entries_by_account
methods.description: Fetches GL entries for accounts within a specified date range and hierarchy.

methods.name: get_additional_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions for filtering GL entries based on dates, projects, cost centers, and other filters.

methods.name: get_cost_centers_with_children
methods.description: Retrieves all child cost centers for specified parent cost centers.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines report columns based on period list and report settings.

methods.name: get_filtered_list_for_consolidated_report
methods.description: Filters period list for consolidated report based on company filter.
